originalTitle: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal crafted a hip hop breakup masterpiece

content: “Breakups are… tough.” It’s the opening lines of an interlude towards the end of DOOMED! Called “It Happens in Every Universe.” It’s also basically the thesis of the entire record. It’s no grand revelation, but it’s a well-trodden subject that Open Mike Eagle manages to mine for artistic gold. Eagle’s subject matter is usually personal, and his productions tinged with nostalgia. But DOOMED! is his most intimate album yet. A lot of that is due to the production from Kenny Segal. The two have traveled in the same orbit and worked together before, but this is the first full-length album release from the two.  These are some of Segal’s most commanding beats since Maps, his 2023 record with Billy Woods. There’s still warbly piano samples, strings, detuned sax melodies, and psychedelic synths, but everything feels more grounded and meaders less. Opener “Out to Lunch” even has fully on-the-grid hi-hats that tick robotically. [Media: https://openmikeeagle.bandcamp.com/album/doomed] That gives way to “Streets of Rage: Public Arguments Edition,” which grooves along with a loose clap, jazzy piano, and confident bassline that recalls the work of Madlib. Over this lowkey funk, Eagle spins an oblique tale of fighting with a significant other. “She cut deep with short barbs, but twist me up with a lil whisper.” It turns out that Segal and Eagle are a perfect pair. The rapper’s melodrama and eye for microscopic details play off the producer’s woozy and forlorn beats that are occasionally punctuated by a sense of foreboding. On the Billy Woods-featuring “She Swear I’m Colorblind,” Eagle intones on the chorus:  > Some reason, shit got twisted,  > Told me it was all my fault, she said > “Pay attention when I talk.” The backing track is stabbed through with bursts of windchimes before ending on a high-pitched whine that feels like the onset of a panic attack. “Unfinished Concrete Initials” contains some of Eagle’s most vulnerable bits, like, “In my daydreams your name’s curse words so I bleeped it,” and: > My memories like landmines and they heinous > Clicking high pootify collaborative playlists > Agonizing over deletions > Flushing evidence, pain is better in secret There are still sparks of Open Mike Eagle’s sense of humor, though. “Schrödinger’s Green Room (There but Uninvited)” opens with him awkwardly proclaiming as if he’s trying to be heard over a bad phone connection, “All my thoughts is intrusive, there’s a DJ in my head, and he picks all his own music, it’s so confusing.” And, as you’d expect from the man who penned “Sweatpants Spiderman,” there are countless pop culture references to anime, Kitty Pride, Beanie Babies, Flipmode Squad, and even The Proclaimers. Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal’s DOOMED! is available on Bandcamp and most major streaming services, including YouTube Music, Apple Music, Spotify, Qobuz, and Deezer.

chineseContent: “分手是……艰难的。”这是《DOOMED》结尾插曲的开场白！被称为“它发生在每个宇宙”。这基本上也是整张唱片的主题。这不是什么伟大的启示，但却是 Open Mike Eagle 成功挖掘艺术黄金的一个常见主题。伊格尔的题材通常是个人的，他的作品带有怀旧色彩。但注定了！这是他迄今为止最亲密的专辑。这很大程度上要归功于肯尼·西格尔的制作。两人此前曾有过相同的轨道并合作过，但这是两人发行的第一张完整专辑。  这些是 Segal 自 2023 年与 Billy Woods 合作录制《Maps》以来最具影响力的歌曲之一。仍然有颤抖的钢琴样本、弦乐、失谐的萨克斯旋律和迷幻的合成器，但一切都感觉更扎实，更少蜿蜒。开场曲“出去吃午饭”甚至有完全在线的踩镲，可以自动滴答作响。 [媒体：https://openmikeeagle.bandcamp.com/album/doomed] 这让位于《愤怒之街：公共争论版》，它伴随着宽松的拍手声、爵士钢琴声和自信的贝斯线，让人想起 Madlib 的作品。在这种低调的恐惧中，伊格尔讲述了一个与另一位重要人物打架的间接故事。 “她用短刺刺得很深，却用轻柔的低语把我扭动起来。”事实证明，西格尔和伊格尔是完美的一对。说唱歌手的情节剧和对微观细节的关注与制作人昏昏欲睡、凄凉的节奏相得益彰，这些节奏偶尔会被一种不祥的预感所打断。在比利·伍兹 (Billy Woods) 的歌曲“她发誓我是色盲”中，伊格尔在副歌部分吟诵道： > 出于某种原因，狗屎被扭曲了， > 告诉我这都是我的错，她说 > “我说话时要注意。”伴奏轨道被阵阵风刺刺穿
